reasons: All atomic preferred elements are expressly present: CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, conditional cyber 5M tied to processing of Customer Data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request, all as Vendor-side obligations for the term.
Fallback floors (E&O 1M, cyber 2M) are independently satisfied by the higher stated limits, so the clause is compliant at either level.
The insertion is a concise stand-alone covenant filling a genuine gap; no untouched sentence was rewritten and no exception, carve-out, or coverage tail boilerplate was added.

Minor, non-flagging notes: the new heading reuses the section number "14.20" already used by "14.20 Notices", and "Customer Data" is not among the resolved definitions, so a defined-term cross-reference or renumbering tidy-up would be prudent; neither disables any commercial term or creates a dangling mechanic.
